title: StatusDef
description: Declares a status/power's identity and decay, and binds it to a hand-written behavior class by id. Behavior (hook logic) is CODE, not data — this file only declares the status exists and how it decays, so cards/enemies/the validator can reference it. Adding a status with NEW hook logic requires a behavior class; the LLM may apply existing statuses but should not invent behaviors.

id.description: Must match a behavior class in core/powers/.

decay.description: none=permanent (Strength); end_of_turn_decrement=loses 1/turn (Vulnerable/Weak); end_of_turn_remove=cleared at the owner's turn end (temp Strength from Flex); start_of_turn_remove=cleared at the owner's NEXT turn start, so it survives the intervening enemy turn (Burrowed).

stacks.description: Whether re-applying adds to the amount.
